intro: Trade Deadline Tuesday: Kansas Cash went full armchair GM on the Chiefs, floated Grok as head coach, cheered a fresh wide receiver arriving, and still found time to plot his master plan to go broke on Stocktwits. The front office should be taking notes.

items.caption: His biggest hit of the day! A no-nonsense scouting report on the Chiefs receiver room, with a nod to Mahomes running for his life. 25 likes of agreement.
items.quote: @T0MFRAUDY He's just not big enough for the NFL.  ANd he spends a lot of time out of bounds while Mahomes is running for his life.

items.caption: The Sunflower State recruiting pitch nobody asked for but everybody needed. Move the team to Kansas and watch the trade deadline fix itself.
items.quote: Once the Kansas City Chiefs move the NFL franchise to Kansas, the trade deadline will be much better.  No player wants to go live in MO.

items.caption: Breaking front-office intel: the GM has an AI on speed dial. AI and football, two of his favorite things in one sentence.
items.quote: Veach is currently in talks with ChatGPT about trade deadline.

items.caption: Why stop at ChatGPT in the front office? He wants @grok on the sideline calling the shots for a week, and asked Grok for its Chiefs trade plan.
items.quote: One of the NFL teams should make @grok the head coach for a week.  What trades would the Kansas City Chiefs make if you were the GM/headcoach today Grok?

items.caption: The news broke that the Chiefs are trading for WR Josh Downs, and our guy summed it up in one word (plus two exclamation points). Mahomes gets another playmaker!
A Tuesday morning wake-up call from the Stocktwits poet laureate. Rise and grind, babe.
items.quote: $SPY $TSLA Wake up babe, we're being evicted

items.caption: Every great fortune needs a strategy, and he's sharing his openly. Step one: buy stuff. Bold, transparent leadership.
items.quote: $SPY As part of my master plan to go broke, I'm buying stuff today.  $TSLA

items.caption: Local news you can use: when someone asked, he broke the news about Kansas internet hours. Get your posts in before bedtime.
items.quote: @ISTEALYOPROFITT Yes, but they shut the internet off in Kansas every night at 9:30PM.
